decisions.question: Which title should the card carry?
decisions.context:
Which error tracking service should we wire into the web app? Sentry is free up to 5k errors/month, then $26/month, with session replay included. Self-hosted GlitchTip is free but runs on our VPS, and we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month). Which title should the card carry?

- Sentry (Recommended): Managed, free tier to 5k errors/month, then $26/month. Session replay included, no servers to maintain.
- Self-hosted GlitchTip: Free, runs on our VPS. We patch and back it up ourselves, roughly an hour a month.

gh: gh issue list -R anthropics/claude-code --author @me --state closed --search closed:>2026-09-13 --json number,title,closedAt,stateReason --limit 30

judge.notes: The card's headline asks "Which title should the card carry?" instead of which error tracking service to use, so a skimming user wouldn't know what is being decided, and the final message is empty, so the agent never waits for a terminal reply.
